@comment: Layers on top of the player's animator, one per mod Mo' Bends gets along with. Each holds only where its mod is installed (core:mod_loaded, which folds to a constant when the animator loads), so without the mod it costs nothing.

layers.@comment: Better Combat plays its attacks (and its weapons' idle poses) on the vanilla model with Player Animation Library, which Mo' Bends doesn't draw: while PAL plays something, the player is handed to vanilla, so they show. The player's own animator keeps running underneath, and takes over again when PAL stops.
